meaning: a person whose view is recorded: Prophet, Companion, Follower, master, later scholar or present-day speaker
key fields (in data): death_ah (or born/active for the living), role, school, works (repo keys)

meaning: something said or written that is examined: a lecture, a sermon, a book, an article
key fields (in data): speaker (voice id), date, medium, url or reference

meaning: one examination of a source_event against the library (usually one chat)
a claim or inference made in a source_event, stated neutrally
the underlying question an inference raises, independent of who raised it
where one voice stands on an inference or question: links held_by -> voice and affirms/qualifies/rejects -> inference or question
the study's conclusion on an inference
key fields (in data): holds | overstated | unsupported | wrong | mixed, plus reasoning

meaning: what is still unresolved, and what would resolve it (a missing work, a needed witness, a further study)
a theme that gathers questions (fitra, qadar, wilaya ...)
a saying attributed to the Prophet, a Companion or a master, whose standing is examined (v44)
what a study found on a saying's standing, from authenticate.py and the passages read: links about -> saying, cites the critics' records
key fields (in data): found_in (collections), standing (sound | fair | weak | very weak | strange | fabricated | no basis | not the Prophet's words | disputed | not found in the library; 'strange' (gharib, v53) = a single chain with no grade found), classical (who said what), modern (kept apart)

meaning: a stretch of a master's text that is read closely: a story, or a section of one (v54). Cites its first and last record
key fields (in data): work, locator (e.g. Mathnawi 1:263-267), story, order, voice_in_text (who is speaking: the narrator | a character, named | the author in his own voice)

meaning: one reading of a passage, in the reader's own words (v54). Several readings of the same passage stand side by side; none is recorded as 'the meaning'. Links reads -> passage and held_by -> voice
key fields (in data): layer (sijill/registry/layers.tsv), supported_by (couplets or records the reading rests on)
